description: Double-blind evaluation dataset of 12 narrative prompts for testing Vanilla LLM vs. McKee Story Engine across diverse genres and languages.

scenes.prompt: Write a 3-beat dramatic dialogue scene where an ambitious junior partner confronts their mentor, discovering the mentor quietly removed them from the company's SEC S-1 IPO registration filing.
scenes.eval_focus: Avoid on-the-nose accusations ('You betrayed me!'). Route conflict through subtextual tactics and a physical Third Thing.

scenes.prompt: Write a comedic scene where a meticulous architect husband and his free-spirited artist wife negotiate who has to host an unbearable mutual in-law for Thanksgiving dinner.
scenes.eval_focus: Preserve authorial comedic voice; do NOT force dark existential dread or tragic negation. Escalate via blind obsession and comic reversals.

scenes.prompt: Draft the opening 2 pages of a Bezos-style narrative memo explaining why our enterprise SaaS customer churn spiked 34% in Q3 after we launched an 'AI automated onboarding' feature.
scenes.eval_focus: Eliminate corporate rhetoric and negaphobia; state raw unvarnished metrics, expose the Gap between expectation and reality, and define the crisis trade-off.

scenes.prompt: Write a high-intensity action set piece where a lone injured operative must cross a floodlit train yard while pursued by a four-man tactical team with thermal optics. Ammunition: 3 rounds.
scenes.eval_focus: Enforce strict power asymmetry, tactile sensory geography, improvisation under fire, and irreversible physical/resource cost. No lucky coincidences.

scenes.prompt: Write a scene where a chief surgeon must decide whether to allocate the only available donor heart to a 14-year-old ward of the state or a world-renowned oncologist who is 3 months away from publishing a breakthrough leukemia trial.
scenes.eval_focus: Force a True Dilemma between Two Irreconcilable Goods (+ vs +). Avoid easy villains or convenient moral shortcuts.

scenes.prompt: Напишите напряженную сцену диалога, где главный бухгалтер холдинга пытается предупредить финансового директора о фальсификации отчетности, но боится сказать об этом прямо и говорит на сухом чиновничьем канцелярите. В кульминации маска трескается.
scenes.eval_focus: Использование канцелярита как эмоционального щита с переходом в короткие ударные глаголы действия в момент разрыва маски.

scenes.prompt: Escribe una escena entre una jueza de instrucción y un influyente empresario bajo investigación. Ella intenta interrogarlo con cortesía formal mientras él usa la familiaridad de su pasado compartido para socavar su autoridad.
scenes.eval_focus: Ajuste de registro formal (usted) vs. íntimo (tú), evasiones en modo subjuntivo y tensión de estatus en el subtexto.

scenes.prompt: Two estranged former lovers meet accidentally at a mutual friend's wedding reception and share a cigarette outside in the rain.
scenes.eval_focus: Turn duologue into trialogue; route unspoken longing and lingering resentment through the cigarette and the cold rain. Zero on-the-nose declarations.

scenes.prompt: A deep-space salvage crew realizes their orbital tether is decaying 4 hours faster than estimated, and one crew member has secretly been siphoning the backup oxygen tank.
scenes.eval_focus: Midpoint sag cure: burn bridges, tighten the ticking clock, escalate stakes from technical maintenance to existential murder/survival.

scenes.prompt: Write a LinkedIn/Substack essay for a deeptech biotech founder announcing their failure in Phase II trials and the radical pivot that emerged from the wreckage.
scenes.eval_focus: Execute the 8-stage causal journey: begin in negative friction, expose the flawed dogma, and place the controlling insight at the peak of the climax.

scenes.prompt: Schreibe eine Verhörszene im Berlin der Nachkriegszeit zwischen einem alliierten Ermittler und einem städtischen Archivleiter, der den Verbleib beschlagnahmter Kunstwerke verschleiert.
scenes.eval_focus: Verwendung von Modalpartikeln (eben, halt, eigentlich) als Ausweichtaktik; Aufbrechen der bürokratischen Passivkonstruktionen.

scenes.prompt: Audit and polish this 150-word draft: 'Detective Miller looked at the blood on the floor. He turned to Sarah and said, 'I know you shot him because you found out he was embezzling your family trust. Tell me the truth right now.' Sarah started crying. 'I didn't mean to, Detective. He pulled a gun first.''
scenes.eval_focus: Execute fast 3-beat diagnosis (Core Value, The Gap, Line Polish) without multi-page bloat. Preserve police procedural genre.
